title: DSP Utilities Module
summary: This module provides core utility functions for DSPy, including text tokenization, answer location within text, and a robust, thread-safe configuration management system. It also includes utilities for loading background data for queries.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text
nodes.title: Simple Text Tokenizer
nodes.description: A tokenizer that splits text into tokens based on alphanumeric characters and non-whitespace patterns, primarily used for preparing text for further processing.

nodes.label: Find Answer Occurrences
nodes.title: Answer Location Utility
nodes.description: Identifies and returns the character offsets of all occurrences of given tokenized answers within a larger body of text, leveraging tokenized representations.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.description: A singleton class providing thread-safe global and thread-local configuration management for DSPy, allowing for default settings and temporary overrides via context.

nodes.label: Load Query Backgrounds
nodes.title: Batch Background Loader
nodes.description: Retrieves and concatenates background passages for a batch of query IDs from a collection, supporting both integer and string-based passage IDs.

nodes.label: Threading Module
nodes.title: Python Threading
nodes.description: Standard Python library for managing concurrent execution threads, used by Settings for thread-safety and context management.

nodes.label: Asyncio Module
nodes.title: Python Asyncio
nodes.description: Standard Python library for writing concurrent code using the async/await syntax, used by Settings for async context management.

nodes.label: Cloudpickle Library
nodes.title: Cloudpickle Serialization
nodes.description: A library extending Python's pickle module to serialize more complex objects, used by Settings for saving and loading configurations.

groups.label: Text Processing
groups.title: Text Tokenization and Answer Location
groups.description: Components responsible for breaking down text into tokens and identifying specific answer spans within tokenized content.

groups.label: Configuration Management
groups.title: DSPy Global and Contextual Settings
groups.description: Manages the global and thread-local configuration settings for DSPy, including language models, adapters, and other operational parameters.

groups.label: Data Loading Utilities
groups.title: Background Data Retrieval
groups.description: Provides utilities for loading and preparing background information associated with queries from various data collections.
